No observer column: each row is one observer's threshold (age in years) on one of three color axes, 511 rows; Axis is a three-level design factor. MPDiR ch. 2 (inst/scripts/Ch2.R) fits nls and Gamma GLMs, glm(Thresh ~ Axis:(I(Age^-1) + Age), family = Gamma(link = 'identity')).

One observer's detection trials, one row per trial with Contrast ('6 luminance contrast levels' and catch trials) and Stim fixed; Rating is the confidence rating, the response, and no column indexes a session or block.

One observer's '16 sessions of 224 trials', stored as the 32 noise samples N of each trial over time; the rows repeat within trials and sessions, but no column indexes either (datasets rock's unindexed cores), and MPDiR ch. 6 estimates the classification image by lm(N ~ time/resp - 1) without a random effect.
One observer's proportion of Yes responses per hue direction (8) and coherence (6), 48 rows; Direction is a design factor, and no model is documented.
Four rows of language counts by UV-B exposure band (Lindsey and Brown 2002), an aggregate table with no grouping column.

Three observers (SH and SS with two runs, MHP with one; Hecht, Shlaer and Pirenne 1942), six light intensities per run. One observer's 2AFC trials from 'two randomly interleaved staircases'; StairCase has two levels, a design factor, and Trial ('the trial number for the staircase') numbers each staircase's own trials, so equal Trial values are different trials; MPDiR ch. 5 fits glm(Response ~ log10(Contrast), binomial(mafc.logit(2))).

One observer's counts NumUpward and NumDownward per cell of Phaseshift, WaveForm, TempFreq and Direction, fixed design factors; MPDiR ch. 4 fits glm(cbind(NumUpward, NumDownward) ~ Direction * WaveForm * TempFreq * Phaseshift, binomial) with several links, and no column indexes a unit.
